reason_not_confirmatory: the 90-task holdout was previously inspected in C1 before C2 was proposed
features: the same frozen 28 structural features used in C1
target_global: pairwise delta utility minus training global pair mean
target_hierarchical: pairwise delta utility minus training family-specific pair mean
hierarchy: joint shared structural block plus one family-specific structural interaction block
tie_policy: exclude abs(delta utility)<0.01 from pairwise fitting and accuracy
aggregation: least-squares Bradley-Terry latent scores with zero-sum constraint
safety_gate: router failure rate must not exceed global-prior failure rate
if_pass: freeze compatibility method, then evaluate once on a new outcome-blind v3 confirmatory set before any FRAR claim
if_fail: do not reconnect FRAR and do not tune lambda on this holdout
